Description.description: The T&C Manager's sign-off on a completed remediation (FR-023, BR-008). Approved closes the case out; Rejected returns it to the adviser with mandatory notes. Owned by the T&C Manager (AD-020, OD-007/AD-031).
Short label identifying the sign-off in lists.
The T&C Manager's sign-off notes. The SignOffRemediation command requires these to be non-empty when the decision is Rejected, so the adviser has a reason to act on (BR-008).
The case this sign-off belongs to. Restrict delete preserves the sign-off record so the outcome and its accountability survive under BR-007 and BR-012.
The remediation action being signed off (BR-008, FR-023). Optional because a sign-off can be recorded at case level. Restrict delete keeps the sign-off traceable to the remediation it validated.
When the T&C Manager recorded the sign-off decision. Empty until signed. Feeds remediation ageing MI under BR-010.
Stable business code for the sign-off. Alternate key, so re-issuing the same sign-off upserts rather than duplicating under NFR-REL-01 (AD-014).
The T&C Manager's validation of the remediation (BR-008, FR-023): Approved closes it out, Rejected returns it to the adviser with notes.
The T&C Manager's validation decision on the remediation: Approved or Rejected (BR-008, FR-023). Owned by the T&C Manager (AD-020, OD-007/AD-031).
